# Performance · concurrency

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Async I/O
- What: Let one worker handle many waiting requests at once instead of waiting on each in turn.
- Applies when: one worker must handle many waits at once.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Bounded fan-out
- What: Run outside calls in parallel, but only a limited number at a time.
- Applies when: the app runs many outside calls in parallel.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Debounce & throttle
- What: Wait for a pause, or cap the rate, before acting on rapid repeated triggers such as typing.
- Applies when: the screen fires rapid triggers, such as search while typing.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Typing quickly in a live search sends one request after the pause, not one per key.

### Pre-aggregation
- What: Keep counts and totals up to date as data changes, instead of adding them up on every request.
- Applies when: counts and totals are slow to compute live.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Load leveling
- What: Put bursts of work in a queue and process them at a steady pace.
- Applies when: work arrives in spikes.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable
